<thought>Based on the observed ESI‑MS peak at m/z 194.0862 (the most intense ion) and assuming it corresponds to the molecular ion (M⁺), the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 194.086 Da. The best‑matching elemental composition that fits this exact mass and shows an M+1 isotopic intensity (~13 %) consistent with ~11–12 carbons is C₁₁H₁₄O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O3</final_answer>
